question.prompt:
4 rays, OA, OB, OC, and OD, extend from point O in this order, and \(\angle AOD\) is less than a straight angle. How many angles less than a straight angle are there in the figure?

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_056_q4_question_en.svg)

solutions.explanation: Each pair of rays forms an angle, giving \(4\times3\div2=6\) angles: \(\angle AOB\), \(\angle AOC\), \(\angle AOD\), \(\angle BOC\), \(\angle BOD\), and \(\angle COD\).
solutions.title: Count pairs of rays
